result.description: Compact creative pen display for sketching, note-taking, and photo retouching. Features a 14-inch laminated IPS panel, 1920 x 1080 resolution, 8192 pressure-level stylus support, dual USB-C connectivity, and an adjustable stand for desktop use. Designed for digital artists and educators who want a portable tablet-like monitor rather than a storage device.
result.title: Aurora Quill 14-inch USB-C Pen Display
